TAROT_FASTING.title: Fasting
TAROT_FASTING.description:
Gain {MagicNumber} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Gain {MagicNumber} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
At the start of each turn, gain 1 less [gold]Energy[/gold].
TAROT_DEVA_FORM.title: Deva Form
TAROT_DEVA_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, gain [gold]Energy[/gold]; the amount increases by {MagicNumber} each turn.
TAROT_BRAWL.title: Brawl
TAROT_BRAWL.description: At the start of your turn, apply {BrawlPower} [gold]Bruise[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TAROT_ETERNAL_FORM.title: Eternal Form
TAROT_ETERNAL_FORM.description: The first 4 playable cards you draw each turn cost {EternalPower} less that turn.
